editionLabel: Steve Jackson Games English rules, version 1.0, January 2013
firstPlayerRule: The previous game's winner starts, or choose whoever makes the best dinosaur sound.
houseFallback: If neither option settles the choice, or your group prefers another approach, agree to choose randomly. This is this site's suggested house rule.
clarifications: Play passes to the left. Remember the starter so everyone receives the same number of turns when the final round is completed.
The dinosaur-sound option is an alternative starting criterion, not a stated tie-break for a previous win.
The extra round between tied leaders decides the winner at the end, not who starts the game.
